description: Implementation class for MerchantStore Data Access Object (DAO), providing methods to retrieve merchant store details and associated products from a database using Hibernate and QueryDSL.

classes.name: MerchantStoreDaoImpl
classes.description: DAO implementation class for merchant store data, extending generic DAO for CRUD operations and adding custom queries.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Retrieves a collection of products associated with a specific merchant store, constructing a complex HQL query with multiple joins and fetches for related entities.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a MerchantStore entity by its ID, including related entities via QueryDSL.

methods.name: getMerchantStore
methods.description: Retrieves a MerchantStore by its code or ID, utilizing QueryDSL to specify fetch joins for related entities.
